svg.aria-label: Four collective operations on four ranks
svg.desc: AllGather copies the rank-ordered first elements 1, 5, 9 and 13. ReduceScatter assigns the column sums 28, 32, 36 and 40. All-to-All sends each input column to its destination. AllReduce replicates the column sums.
svg.text: Each column goes to its destination
